metric_justifications.accuracy: Accuracy measures the total proportion of correctly classified sequences. Achieved 95.9% overall correctness across all classes on unseen test fragments.
metric_justifications.precision: Precision (Positive Predictive Value) quantifies how often a disease prediction is truly correct. In genomic screening, high precision minimizes false positives, sparing patients from traumatic misdiagnoses and unnecessary invasive procedures.
metric_justifications.recall: Recall (Sensitivity) measures the model's ability to detect all true positive cases of a genetic disorder. In clinical genetics, high recall is vital to prevent false negatives—missing a life-threatening cancer predisposition (HBOC, LFS) or treatable metabolic defect.
metric_justifications.f1_score: F1-Score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall. It serves as the primary balanced benchmark accounting for natural class imbalances across genes of varying transcript lengths.
metric_justifications.leakage_prevention: Strict Leakage Prevention Protocol: (1) Stratified partitioning before vectorization; (2) Vectorizer vocabulary and inverse document frequencies (IDF) learned strictly on X_train; (3) Zero test set exposure during model fitting or threshold tuning; (4) Evaluated on 317 independent test sequences.
